_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO SEED — these are representative figures so `npm run dev` shows a live-looking unified-liquidity layer out of the box (the cockpit's Spoke Vaults / Liquidity views read this file). They are NOT on-chain balances. A real deploy via scripts/create_multivm_token.js writes deployments/liquidity-state.local.json (gitignored) with the actual issued balances, and server.ts prefers that file when it exists.
